debts.title: Rebuild Rupesh v0.2.3 thesis with the confirmed title
debts.description: The public registry title is confirmed as 'Seismic Vulnerability Assessment and Retrofitting of Non-Engineered Reinforced Concrete Buildings in Pokhara Metropolitan City', but the current v0.2.3 thesis PDF and LaTeX still carry the older 'Evaluation of Retrofitting Strategies' wording.
debts.close_when: A governed newer thesis build uses the confirmed title, passes QA, is provider-read back, and replaces the working PDF/source pointers.

debts.title: Discussion lane has no authoritative current artifact
debts.description: The designated Discussion Drive location is empty; no Google Doc or discussion pointer is published.
debts.close_when: A real authoritative Discussion Google Doc exists and its provider-read Drive ID is registered.

debts.title: Presentation lane has no authoritative current artifact
debts.description: The designated Presentation Drive location is empty; no PPTX/PDF pointer is published.
debts.close_when: A governed presentation source/output exists and its provider-read Drive pointers are registered.

debts.title: MScH corpus B013 remains deliberately held
debts.description: CP12/B012 is the last closed provider-readback boundary. B013 has PRE state but no governed POST/checkpoint and must not be resumed under the current user directive.
debts.close_when: Only after an explicit user directive releases the hold and B013 is executed, POST/read back, and checkpointed.
